title: Titanium Craniofacial Mesh
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this craniofacial application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by reconstruction mesh for craniofacial repair (cp-ti) and specific design requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for craniofacial geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for reconstruction mesh for application
commonFailures: Galvanic pitting at Ti-316L interface in vivo - eliminated by ceramic Al2O3 coating on mating surfaces — critical for reconstruction mesh for performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Craniofacial Mesh suitable for Reconstruction mesh for craniofacial repair (CP-Ti)?
faq.a: Titanium Craniofacial Mesh uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address craniofacial operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Craniofacial Mesh?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Craniofacial Mesh is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for reconstruction mesh for requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Craniofacial Mesh require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. reconstruction mesh for components require Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for reconstruction mesh for application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Craniofacial Mesh shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Craniofacial Mesh includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet reconstruction mesh for specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Bone mesh / Facial implant craniofacial components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
